params.name: depth
params.description: Maximum levels returned per side. Clamped to [1, 100]. Default 20.

items.docs:
> ⚠️ This endpoint is in [public preview](/preview/roadmap).

Depth of book for the given requirements and delivery window, aggregated by instance SKU and price level. Individual orders and participants are not exposed.

params.name: since_at
params.description: Lower bound on the contract's `created_at` (when the fill was recorded). Unix epoch seconds. Defaults to `now - 7d`. Must be no more than 30 days before `now`; older values return 422.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum results to return. Clamped to [1, 200]. Default 50.

params.name: starting_after
params.description: Set to the response's `cursor` to fetch the next (older) page.

items.docs:
> ⚠️ This endpoint is in [public preview](/preview/roadmap).

All contracts that filled on hardware meeting the requirements for the given delivery window, sorted newest first. One row per fill (contract), including the instance SKU. Participant identity is never exposed.

> ⚠️ This endpoint is in [public preview](/preview/roadmap).

Top-of-book quote (best bid + best ask) for the given requirements and delivery window. Returned price levels include the matching instance SKU.

params.name: range_start_at
params.description: Start of the delivery-window range to browse. Unix epoch seconds, minute-aligned.

params.name: range_end_at
params.description: End of the delivery-window range to browse. Unix epoch seconds, minute-aligned, must be > `range_start_at`.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum results to return. Clamped to [1, 200]. Default 50.

params.name: starting_after
params.description: Set to the response's `cursor` to fetch the next page.

items.docs:
> ⚠️ This endpoint is in [public preview](/preview/roadmap).

List every instance SKU and delivery window with resting orders matching the requirements, within the given time range. Each row is a summary; use /quote or /depth for detail on a specific SKU window.
